published_figures.note: None. Every figure that is only published (an index reading, a rate of s 126(a), the highest rate of s 121, the scale of s 121, an order of the Minister) is an input with no default. The amounts printed in the RE Tax Law's s 9 for 2025 are in the text of the Law itself.

scope: Encoded: the Rounding Order 5746-1986 ss 1-13, 15, 17 with s 120B(d) as the join; Ordinance s 88 (the definitions the rate sections use); ss 125B, 125C, 122, 91 ((a), (b)(1)-(3), (b1), (c), (e), (f), (g); (b2) for a body of persons), 8(c), 64A1, 64A2 (three definitions), 57, 55(b), 60A(b)(2); the RE Tax Law's s 6(b), s 48A (except (e), (b3) declined) and s 9 (the bands printed for 2025 and their indexation from 16 January 2028). Dates before 1 January 2012 (the change date) are declined for ss 91, 125B, 125C and 48A; the purchase tax is answered from 16 January 2025. Out of scope or not finished, each with its reason: see NOTES.md section 2.

tax_years_answered.ss 91, 125B, 125C, 48A: a sale, dividend or payment on or after 1 January 2012
tax_years_answered.RE Tax Law s 9: a sale from 16 January 2025 (printed amounts to 15 January 2028; from 16 January 2028 with the index readings supplied)

forks.30-F1: s 120B(d): an amount the Order names no rule for. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG): declined by default; stays as adjusted.
forks.30-F2: s 88 'alone or together with another'. SHRUG: any number of others; one other only; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F3: s 88 how the days of 'the period from A to B' are counted. SHRUG: both ends; the days between; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F4: s 88 half of the holding expenses left out of the adjusted price. SHRUG: lost; added back; declined where there are holding expenses.
forks.30-F5: the twelve months before a day (s 88 with ss 91, 125B, 125C, 48A). SHRUG: from the day twelve months before; from the day after; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F6: s 125B(3) names no time for the shareholding. SHRUG: at receipt only; at receipt or in the twelve months; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F7: s 91(b)(3) names no time for the shareholding. SHRUG: at the sale only; at the sale or in the twelve months; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F8: a cap 'not exceeding' where the gain stands in several bands. SHRUG: each band capped; the average capped; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F9: where the three parts of a gain stand in the top layer. SHRUG: alone; earliest lowest; earliest highest; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F10: s 91(f)(1) and RE Tax Law s 48A(d)(1): the years from 1949. SHRUG: both ends counted; the year of acquisition not; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F11: s 91(f)(2) and RE Tax Law s 48A(d)(2): the years from 2005. SHRUG: 2005 and the sale year both; 2005 not; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F12: s 91(b1)(1A): whether the middle part is also reduced by the distributable profits. SHRUG: all three parts; the middle part not; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F13: s 8(c)(1): a difference older than six tax years. SHRUG: year of receipt; earliest of the six; declined.
forks.30-F14: s 8(c)(3): working years that end before the year of receipt. SHRUG: those inside the six; the last six working years; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F15: s 64A2 'exceptional income' (2): the 5% test. SHRUG: all the other income once over 5%; only the part above 5%; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F16: RE Tax Law s 47: which calendar year names a tax year that begins on 1 April. SHRUG: the year it begins in; the year it ends in; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F17: RE Tax Law s 9(c1f): printed to end 31 December 2024, the consolidation's note says extended to 31 December 2026. SHRUG: ends 2024; ends 2026; declined where they differ.
forks.30-F18: RE Tax Law s 9(c2): where a half of 5 shillings goes. SHRUG: up; down; declined where they differ.
